title: The best habit tracker on the market.
body:
I’ve tried every habit tracking software out there. I’ve tested only online, browser-based software, including those for macOS, iPadOS, and iPhone OS. 

In fact, I’ve tested each of them for at least two weeks, subscribing to or purchasing the app where needed. Some of them had a lot of features but were full of bugs, and lacked export options, locking the data into the app. 

There were others that worked well but mixed up the data. And some were bearable, but had a JSON export that wasn’t very useful. 

I was about to give up my long search when I came across the Awesome Habits software. 

I started testing it, and the developer was constantly helping me because I had plenty of questions. Once I saw that this app was good, I purchased it. And it’s been perfect ever since, especially the CSV export. 

Before I found a good app, I used to write everything by hand in Apple Numbers. Since I got Awesome Habits, I don’t need to write by hand anymore because the CSV export is truly perfect, so my data is safe.
author: Christian Hodek

title: Great visuals! Simple to use!
body: Been loving the look of the app. It doesn’t also have any unnecessary functionality that just gets in the way!
